notes:
## New features
- Report basis in exports. Exported results carry a "Report basis" sheet: the calculation run and whether its results still match the model, the method (ISO 9613-2:2024 with the ground, screening, reflection and meteorological settings used), the software validation measured for this build (ISO/TR 17534-3:2015 test cases T01-T18, all within +/-0.5 dB) and the notes to state in a report. It replaces the old readiness sheet.
- One basemap bar everywhere. The Contours Map page uses the same A/B basemap bar as the Editor, and the Contours preview, sheet export and 3D view apply the same per-layer opacity, contrast, colour or black-and-white, and blend mode. Each sheet keeps its own basemap choices.
- Barrier colours in 3D. Barriers in the 3D view use the display colour chosen for each barrier.
- Calculation date on sheets. Contour sheets state when the result was calculated ("Calculated ... UTC"), on by default.
- Quiet calculations. A setting that uses half the cores so long runs stay cooler and quieter; results are identical.

## Changes
- Receptor calculations use most of the processor (limited by free memory) instead of four workers, and keep one warm pool for all periods and the mitigation comparison in a request. Results are identical; P2001 runs about 1.7x faster from cold and 3.4x across periods.
- The 3D view opens far faster on projects with many ground points (P2001: about 9.6 s to 2 s to build), and draws surveyed ground points as one object.
- SmartSmooth keeps smoothing where an edge conflicts with a neighbour: such edges now use a gently smoothed shape instead of the stepped raw line.
- The compliance appendix and readiness statement describe the validated scope accurately and in plain words; reflections and line, area and transport sources are no longer described as unreliable.
- The Results table gives the level columns room; only the receptor name stretches.

## Bug fixes
- The clause-inspection trace no longer fails for barriers whose top edge does not block the line of sight.
- Contour NG no longer fails on small loops when no integrity surface is available.
- Calculated contour grids record their calculation time, so the sheet footer date option works.
- Several other rarely-reached code paths that referred to undefined names are fixed, and a test now prevents this class of error.
